prompt:
Pixel art for a 16-bit style side-view arena shooter that runs at 640x360. Edit the attached template in place: it is drawn on a chunky pixel grid where one art pixel is exactly 1/240 of the image width; keep exactly that pixel size (never finer, never subdivided), and keep every size anchor and guide position. Crisp hard pixels: a clean 1-pixel near-black outline around every character, Enemy and prop; flat cel shading with 3-4 tones per material, shadows leaning purple-blue and highlights leaning warm yellow, light from the upper left; no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no soft edges, no semi-transparent pixels (use a checkerboard dither for any in-between tone). Characters are seen in a three-quarter side view (Metal Slug style): facing right, head and chest turned slightly toward the viewer. No text, no watermark, no shadows on the ground unless asked.

Edit image 1. It shows 4 identical pixel-art copies of Rexi, a very muscular judge in a sleeveless black robe over a white tank top, grey trousers and brown boots, facing right in a three-quarter side view. Image 2 is a concept drawing of the same man from the same side, for reference only: do not copy its size or its pixel density.

He faces right, so his RIGHT side faces the viewer: his NEAR arm, the big bare arm hanging at his side on the LEFT of each copy (closest to the viewer, in front of the robe), is his RIGHT arm. Repaint ONLY that near arm in every copy:
1) The whole upper arm, from the robe's torn armhole at the shoulder down to the elbow, becomes one fully inked sleeve tattoo: dark brown-black ink with continuous linework covering the entire upper arm, wrapping around it with no bare skin left between the motifs and no separate small pictures. Read it as one piece from top to bottom: a lion's face at the shoulder (two eyes and a nose in skin colour peeking through the ink), its mane flowing down the arm in curling ink strands that turn into three vertical courthouse columns under a small triangular pediment, with a dark band of steps at the elbow where the sleeve ends. As in image 2.
2) The forearm and the fist stay bare skin; give the bare forearm and the deltoid clear muscle shading with three skin tones, lit from the upper left.
Remove the old tattoo marks (a small lion badge and a small box) completely: the sleeve replaces them.

Keep everything else exactly identical to the copy: the same arm outline and silhouette, the head, hair, face, tank top, robe, far fist, trousers, boots, colours, pixel size, height (64 pixels) and position. The 4 copies stay identical to each other. Chunky pixel art at exactly the same pixel size, 1-pixel dark outline, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, flat pure white background, no text.

pipeline.note: Rexi master: right-arm sleeve on the near arm (Refs #26)
